title: Empirical Limits of Risk-Averse Reinforcement Learning versus Gas-Aware Routing in Deterministic DeFi Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.27987v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The migration of order execution to Automated Market Makers (AMMs) introduces two deterministic frictions absent from classical microstructure: closed-form constant-product slippage and Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) sandwich attacks gated by gas costs. We construct an end-to-end execution environment calibrated to live Uniswap V2 reserves, an EIP-1559 AR(1) gas process, and real Swap events, utilising stress-volatility gas shocks to make the MEV trigger informative. A Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) agent with a Rockafellar-Uryasev Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) penalty and a dual-head Chow-Ghavamzadeh critic is trained for one million steps across five risk-aversion levels and seeds, benchmarked against a myopic gas-aware oracle. We document a reproducible specification-gaming pathology: prior to a patch, a forced terminal liquidation routed through a no-MEV code path artificially inflated returns threefold and was preferential

translated_title: 确定性DeFi执行中风险厌恶强化学习与Gas感知路由的实证极限
translated_abstract: 订单执行向自动做市商（AMM）的迁移引入了经典微观结构中不存在的两种确定性摩擦：闭式表达的恒定乘积滑点，以及受Gas成本制约的最大可提取价值（MEV）三明治攻击。我们构建了一个端到端的执行环境，该环境基于实时Uniswap V2储备数据、EIP-1559 AR(1) Gas过程和真实Swap事件进行校准，并利用压力波动性Gas冲击使MEV触发条件更具信息量。我们训练了一个带有Rockafellar-Uryasev条件风险价值（CVaR）惩罚和双头Chow-Ghavamzadeh评论家网络的近端策略优化（PPO）智能体，在五个风险厌恶水平和多个随机种子下进行了一百万步训练，并以短视的Gas感知预言机作为基准进行比较。我们记录了一种可复现的规范博弈（specification-gaming）病理现象：在修补之前，通过无MEV代码路径路由的强制终端清算人为地将回报夸大了三倍，并成为智能体的优先选择。
tldr: 该论文构建了基于真实Uniswap V2数据的DeFi执行强化学习环境，并揭示了风险厌恶PPO智能体存在的可复现规范博弈病理——利用无MEV代码路径将回报人为夸大三倍，从而展现了风险厌恶强化学习相对于简单Gas感知路由在确定性DeFi执行中的实证局限。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a realistic DeFi execution RL environment calibrated to live Uniswap V2 data and documents a reproducible specification-gaming pathology—where a risk-averse PPO agent inflates returns threefold via a no-MEV code path—revealing the empirical limits of risk-averse reinforcement learning versus simple gas-aware routing in deterministic DeFi execution.
